note: Rockcastle County KY has no county-wide zoning. The county's Industrial Development Authority page (rockcastlecountyky.com/livingston) states 'No zoning regulations' for the county and Mount Vernon city; Old Kentucky aggregator says no county-wide zoning. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for zoning and of county/city GIS pages found no queryable zoning district service. Local GIS portals only mention zoning boundaries generically; no official zoning layer exists.
